classification: Work in progress, not for integration. The proper local fix for the #1270 approach exposes pre-existing stepper defects, and the follow-on fixes break other pinned behaviors.

changes.D1 walkable clearance: CharacterMovement.WalkablePush.cs. A moving body keeps real overlap recovery along the MTV, and only the skin clearance of a walkable push is vertical.
changes.D2 forward tread-find: PropSupportFloor reads only the tread-fan half ahead of the intended travel.
changes.D3 surface step drop: DropsBeyondStep measures a ledge drop from the supporting contact, shared by the GroundedEpsilon stick and the step-down hold.
changes.D4 nearer landing: TryStepUp retries a half and quarter advance when the one-radius landing is not walkable.

results: D1 only: the #1270 approach arrives in 14 steps at 0.41 mm. Movement project fails only the 7 known Task 7 raw-point hypotheses. Game Locomotion and Physics namespaces fail 4 of 1399: StepDownBeyondStepHeight 0.45 and three ShallowTreadStaircaseBase walk rows. The three run-climb penetration rows that broke the #1265 broad attempt pass.
Old code deterministic sweep: shallow-tread staircase walk stalls on all 21 starts at 2 m/s, none at 3 or 4 m/s. D1 stalls all 21 at 3 m/s, none at 2 or 4 m/s.
Step-down sweep r 0.4: old code steps up to 0.44 m. D1 steps 0.43 to 0.51 m by rolling over the edge, and 0.41 and 0.42 fall after the tread-find re-grabs the ledge behind the body.
D1 to D4: new and existing targets pass, 29 of 29. Locomotion-dependent projects: Game 17 of 2459 fail, Movement 7 known hypotheses, Server, TileWorld.Physics and MapEditor pass.

Attribution with D4 disabled: D4 alone causes 11 ConsumerStairBaseMount run rows, SteeperGrade_RunClimb and two run StairGlide streams. D1 to D3 still fail Capsule_MountsDomeFromSide_ByJumping, IsolatedStepDown_StampsNegativeStepDelta and the walk-descend StairGlide stream.
limits: Diagnostic sweeps ran through temporary instrumentation that is not in this commit. The sweep source is preserved beside the logs as TempWalkablePushTrace.cs.txt.
Not integrated. Owner decision pending on the stepper direction versus #438.
